requirement: New customers complete the approved two-stage onboarding tour

oracle.invariant: The start screen exposes three choices and uses the real Create a new site control. The ready-site tour keeps ten consecutive counters when start cards unmount. Edit only advances after actual mode, selection and an acknowledged send. Composer chips submit through the current session input actions, and completion is remembered. Tour headings, body, navigation, progress aria labels and interpolated counters use the supplied locale lookup; every composer chip sends its displayed translated text. Translated Edit and selected-box Send controls advance the tour; people-only notes, other requests and send intent without acknowledgement cannot advance it.
oracle.productSourceGap: no product file is imported, read or run through a supported form in the command's test files (see tests/qa/layers/unit/lib/sources.mjs)

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

the first screen has three choices
site story keeps ten consecutive counters

selected-box Enter accepts only its own successful request
